result.summary: Modified .emergency-fab.fab-panel-expanded rule to keep the emergency button visible when the mobile panel is expanded. Changed opacity from 0 to 1, pointer-events from none to auto, transform from scale(0.8) to scale(1), added z-index:1002, repositioned bottom to calc(75vh + 8px) so FAB sits above the expanded panel.
